title: FEATURE REQUEST: Different "Carb absorption rate" for food with different glycemic index
body:
I have idea to improve "Predictive Simulation Settings".
You can there set "Carb absorption rate".
It's important parameter.
That's why I think it should be improved.

I'm talking about:
"Carb absorption rate" should be customizible for let's say fast/med/slow carbs (based on different food glycemic index) (which, if necessary, combinible) like different graphs for different insulins in "Multiple Insulin Types" or definible by user in number values.

Thanks.

comments.body:
I also think this would be useful as I've noticed that while the general algorithm works for a meal with a mix of GI types, it's not very good for specific food stuffs at either end of the spectrum.

With that said it would require a different predictive algorithm to make it worthwhile, which is probably a different feature request.

I'm also conscious that the best solution here may be to use a different app to input relevant data about food/drink consumed (so it could be all singing and dancing with meal planning, food db, etc., or just a basic set of input fields - XDrip doesn't need to care) and for XDrip to simply provide an end-point to allow upload of this data into XDrip via its web API for use internally in the prediction algorithm.

This issue is similar to #1519 and addresses the same problem by adjustment of the carb absorption rather than by choosing it during/with the carb input.

Having both options would be quite confusing. If I remember correctly, most loop systems require that GI/GL is provided during carb input.

@ARkaine2 
Please use the existing open issue to propose any additions or improvements.
If you believe that this should be open for a reason, please explain why before reopening.
Thanks
